name: Tanaris Field Sampling
summary: In Tanaris, a field test begins as soon as the kit's power source is switched on. Your two hours of sampling start then.

sections.title: A Ticking Power Source
sections.body:
Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle expected the kit to glow and vibrate once its power source was running. Now you have two hours to gather acceptable samples from eight basilisks, eight hyenas and eight scorpions in the Tanaris desert.

If the time runs out, all the data is lost. You will need to buy another power source from Bilgewhizzle, then return the kit to him in Gadgetzan before its power gives out.

sections.title: The Company's Profit
sections.body:
Bilgewhizzle offers no sympathy when a kit goes dead. The Gadgetzan Water Company’s profit is all that matters to him.

He will keep selling power sources until the company can afford to import water from the icy springs of Dun Morogh.

faq.q: What creatures need to be sampled for the testing kit?
faq.answer: Gather acceptable samples from eight Tanaris basilisks, eight hyenas and eight scorpions.

faq.q: How much time is available to complete the sampling?
faq.answer: You have two hours from the moment the power source is switched on.

faq.q: What happens if the power source runs out?
faq.answer: All the data in the kit is lost. To begin again, buy another power source from Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.

faq.q: Where does the testing kit go once full?
aliases: who do i turn this in to
faq.answer: Return the full testing kit to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan before its power gives out.

faq.q: Why does Bilgewhizzle keep selling power sources?
faq.answer: Bilgewhizzle wants the Gadgetzan Water Company to profit. He will keep selling power sources until it can afford to import water from the icy springs of Dun Morogh.
